summary: Unregistered Lean finite controls in Results.Modal.OptimalCreationChoice.Solution on the existing OptimalCreationChoice/SelectedEffectBridge profiles. Reused, not new: a necessary source with varying or absent activity (NecessaryContingentActivity.necessaryWithContingentActivity #435, NecessaryVariableEffects.necessarySourceVariableEffects #462) and the creation/omission profiles SimplicityCollapse.optionalAct and inefficaciousAct (#555 Core). New: threeWorldCreationChecks (one rigid necessary source, two contingent created effects and an omission world; a selection table read from the world label tracks outputs at all worlds while a fixed actual-matching tag fails), threeWorldOptimalOutputs, and the optimality layer soleCreatedUnique, optionalOmissionOptimal, universalOmissionOutputOptimal, universalOmissionNotTotal, omissionChoiceChecks: a unique created optimum plus optimality of every actual output does not yield StableActOutput without positive-output totality; whether a create-or-refrain rationality principle supplies totality is open. omissionStructureChecks composes failed stability of inefficaciousAct from #555 Core. beingCarriesActApplication: under #555's BeingCarriesAct reading only the always-performed profile survives, where creating versus omitting is carried by the world label alone (the inefficacious, extrinsic branch, structurally the brute-selection rival). Rejected shortcuts: capacity-to-exercise, best-created-to-must-create, matching-table-to-intention, fixed-act-to-fixed-effect.
